quick_skim.title: Full-field and Bloch-periodic-factor discretizations: Accuracy and phantom modes
quick_skim.abstract: One can distinguish four major formulations of the Bloch-mode problem in linear periodic media. First, there are two common complementary ways of slicing the Bloch variety (Bloch wave vectors paired with the corresponding frequencies): frequency vs. wave vector or, conversely, wave vector vs. frequency. This paper deals exclusively with the latter option, directly applicable to lossy media, evanescent waves, and complex band structures.   A separate crossroads is the full field (FF) vs. the lattice-periodic Bloch factor (PF) formulations. These are fully equivalent on the continuous level, but common discretization techniques may break this equivalence not just approximately but qualitatively. In the FF problem, the primary unknown eigenvalue is the Bloch phase factor (not the wavenumber), which enters only through opposite-boundary coupling. The PF formulation, on the other hand, injects the Bloch wavenumber into the differential operator and leads to a volume quadratic pencil. Consequently, standard PF discretizations of the type considered here, in contrast with the corresponding FF discretizations, violate the reciprocal-lattice (Brillouin-zone-shift) covariance -- which, as the theory and numerical examples in the paper show, may lead to inaccurate or even nonphysical modes.   From the mathematical perspective, the paper highlights the role of structure-preserving algorithms. The practical importance of the results and recommendations stems from the wide adoption of PF formulations in optics, photonics, and beyond -- such as the computation of propagating and evanescent Bloch modes in photonic and acoustic structures, topological photonics, effective-mass and topological insulator band theories.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper examines the accuracy and phantom modes of full-field and Bloch-periodic-factor discretizations for Bloch-mode problems in linear periodic media, showing that discretization can break their continuous equivalence and introduce spurious modes, providing guidance for reliable simulation of periodic structures such as diffractive waveguides.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文针对线性周期介质中布洛赫模问题，比较全场与布洛赫周期因子离散化格式的精度与伪模问题。研究发现离散化可能破坏连续层面的等价性并引入伪模，从而影响周期结构（如衍射光波导）的数值模拟可靠性。文章给出了避免伪模的指导，为光栅和波导的计算设计提供了方法参考。
